The JSON Schemas ForgeCycle 0.6.0 validates configuration, run state, handoff front matter, and roadmap files against. See [Protocol and state machine](/documentation/reference/protocol/) for how they are used.

| Schema | Describes |
| --- | --- |
| [`builder-result.schema.json`](/documentation/schemas/builder-result.schema.json) | Describes the stored artifact. On input, ForgeCycle fills schema_version, run_id, turn, base_revision, head_revision, and each required test's command when omitted, expands abbreviated revisions, and rewrites equivalent required-test commands to the exact required string (ADR 0016, ADR 0018). Status completed requires every test passed, except that gated and after-gate tests may be not_run (ADR 0023, ADR 0037); failing or other not_run tests are reported under partial. |
| [`config.schema.json`](/documentation/schemas/config.schema.json) | ForgeCycle configuration |
| [`decomposition.schema.json`](/documentation/schemas/decomposition.schema.json) | ForgeCycle large-plan decomposition response |
| [`handoff-frontmatter.schema.json`](/documentation/schemas/handoff-frontmatter.schema.json) | ForgeCycle handoff front matter |
| [`notification-log.schema.json`](/documentation/schemas/notification-log.schema.json) | One line of <git-common-dir>/forgecycle/observability/notifications.ndjson, the history of runs that needed an operator (ADR 0027). The command that owns a run appends a raised record when it leaves the run stopped for an operator; the command whose state save clears the stop appends a resolved record. Readers fold records by key: the first raised and the first resolved record of a key win, and lines that do not parse are skipped. |
| [`planner-plan.schema.json`](/documentation/schemas/planner-plan.schema.json) | ForgeCycle Planner plan front matter |
| [`reviewer-review.schema.json`](/documentation/schemas/reviewer-review.schema.json) | Describes the stored artifact. On input, ForgeCycle fills schema_version, run_id, turn, base_revision, head_revision, and each required test's command when omitted, expands abbreviated revisions, and rewrites equivalent required-test commands to the exact required string (ADR 0016, ADR 0018). Every currently required test must be present with an equivalent command; an added test needs a justification and must pass the configured command lint rules. |
| [`roadmap-questions.schema.json`](/documentation/schemas/roadmap-questions.schema.json) | The Decomposer's answer to roadmap questions: rewrites of the decisions the human marked unclear, under their own IDs, and decisions a roadmap's Planners and Reviewers would stop to ask that its decisions document does not hold yet, which ForgeCycle numbers after the document's highest Q ID and appends as open decisions (ADR 0028). Each question has the fields of a decomposition question (decomposition.schema.json#/$defs/question). |
| [`roadmap-run-state.schema.json`](/documentation/schemas/roadmap-run-state.schema.json) | State of one roadmap run, stored in .forgecycle/roadmap-runs/<roadmap-run-id>/state.json and replaced atomically (ADR 0026). |
| [`roadmap.schema.json`](/documentation/schemas/roadmap.schema.json) | The machine-readable roadmap that roadmap decompose writes and roadmap runs read. Array order is execution order; each task depends only on earlier tasks. Paths are relative to the manifest's directory. |
| [`state.schema.json`](/documentation/schemas/state.schema.json) | ForgeCycle run state |
